items.title: AFDBench: A Reasoning-First AI Scientist for NationalWeather Service Forecast Discussions
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) hallucinate numerical values when generating high-stakes meteorological text, posing risks for weather communication. We present AFDBench, an AI meteorologist that generates professional Area Forecast Discussions (AFDs) by reasoning through structured AI weather forecast data from Google's WeatherNext 2. We introduce AFDBench, the first benchmark for evaluating generative meteorological reasoning, comprising 7,732 expert written discussions from 13 National Weather Service (NWS) offices paired with real AI weather forecast inputs, and three complementary metrics: Met-Align (numerical accuracy), Style-Align (professional dialect adherence), and Input-Grounding (fidelity to source weather data). Zero-shot evaluations reveal that open-source LLMs achieve low Style-Align (~0.33) and moderate Input-Grounding (~0.88), failing to write in the professional NWS register or faithfully use their input data. We apply Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with domain-specific rewards targeting temperature accuracy, synoptic correctness, and format compliance. On 1,033 held-out samples from two unseen NWS offices, GRPO nearly doubles Style-Align from 0.318 to 0.619 and improves Input-Grounding from 0.881 to 0.940, demonstrating that reinforcement learning teaches a 7B-parameter model to write like a professional meteorologist and faithfully interpret AI weather data.
items.summary_zh: AFDBench 以真实天气预测输入和专家撰写的预报讨论文本，评估模型的数值准确性、专业文体和输入忠实度，并报告 GRPO 后的留出集结果。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作将生成式气象推理拆成可度量的任务指标，并在未见 NWS 办公室的样本上检验训练效果，避免只凭流畅文本判断系统可靠性。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在生成高风险气象文本时会幻觉出数值，这给天气传播带来风险。我们提出 AFDBench：一个通过推理 Google WeatherNext 2 的结构化 AI 天气预报数据来生成专业区域预报讨论（AFD）的 AI 气象学家。我们推出 AFDBench，这是首个评估生成式气象推理的基准，包含来自 13 个 National Weather Service（NWS）办公室的 7,732 份专家撰写讨论及其配对的真实 AI 天气预报输入，并设有三项互补指标：Met-Align（数值准确性）、Style-Align（专业方言遵循度）和 Input-Grounding（对源天气数据的忠实度）。零样本评估显示，开源 LLM 的 Style-Align 较低（约 0.33）、Input-Grounding 中等（约 0.88），既无法以专业 NWS 文体写作，也无法忠实使用输入数据。我们采用 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO），并设置针对温度准确性、天气形势正确性和格式合规性的领域奖励。在来自两个未见 NWS 办公室的 1,033 个留出样本上，GRPO 将 Style-Align 从 0.318 提升至 0.619，接近翻倍，并将 Input-Grounding 从 0.881 提升至 0.940，表明强化学习能够教会一个 7B 参数模型以专业气象学家的方式写作并忠实解读 AI 天气数据。
items.author_line: Manmeet Singh, Somnath Luitel, Prabhjot Singh, Manraaj Banga, Naveen Sudharsan, Josh Durkee

items.title: Trace Integrity for LLM Data Agents: A Vision for Auditable Structured Reasoning in Real-World Systems
items.abstract_or_text: Answer accuracy is an insufficient reliability signal for LLM data agents. In structured-data tasks, a benchmark-correct answer can be produced by an invalid trace. This paper introduces Trace Integrity, a deployment reliability criterion for evaluating whether the computation recorded behind an answer is explicit, executable, schema-valid, operator-faithful, replayable, answer-consistent, and auditable. We identify the Structure Gap as the deployment failure mode that makes Trace Integrity necessary: natural-language reasoning and free-form rationales do not reliably specify the operator-level programs required by real-world systems. We operationalize Trace Integrity with execution contracts, structured artifacts that bind user intent to schema elements, operator plans, assumptions, executable queries, verification status, and final-answer linkage. We also introduce CAIT (Correct Answer / Invalid Trace) Rate, which measures how often answer-only evaluation counts computationally unsupported outputs as successes. In an empirical demonstration on BIRD Mini-Dev, Direct SQL, Operation Summary + SQL, and Contract-First SQL achieve answer accuracies of 20%, 22%, and 24%, while their Trace Integrity Pass Rates are 39%, 43%, and 40% and their CAIT Rates remain high at 55%, 59.1%, and 45.8%, showing that answer accuracy, trace validity, and silent-failure risk are distinct evaluation signals. Real-world LLM data agents should, therefore, be evaluated not only by whether their outputs match a reference answer, but by whether those outputs are backed by auditable computation.
items.summary_zh: Trace Integrity 提出用可执行、模式有效、可重放且与答案一致的计算轨迹评估 LLM 数据代理，并以 CAIT Rate 揭示仅评答案可能掩盖无效计算。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把答案正确性与计算过程的可审计性分开度量，为结构化数据代理提供了可复查的可靠性指标。
items.abstract_zh: 答案准确性不足以作为 LLM 数据代理的可靠性信号。在结构化数据任务中，一个基准正确的答案可能由无效轨迹产生。本文提出 Trace Integrity，这是一项部署可靠性准则，用于评估答案背后记录的计算是否明确、可执行、模式有效、忠于算子、可重放、与答案一致并可审计。我们识别出使 Trace Integrity 必不可少的部署失效模式——Structure Gap：自然语言推理和自由形式理由无法可靠地指定真实系统所需的算子级程序。我们通过执行契约来操作化 Trace Integrity；这些结构化产物将用户意图与模式元素、算子计划、假设、可执行查询、验证状态及最终答案关联起来。我们还提出 CAIT（Correct Answer / Invalid Trace）Rate，用于衡量只评估答案时将计算上缺乏支持的输出算作成功的频率。在 BIRD Mini-Dev 上的实证演示中，Direct SQL、Operation Summary + SQL 和 Contract-First SQL 的答案准确率分别达到 20%、22% 和 24%，而其 Trace Integrity Pass Rate 分别为 39%、43% 和 40%，CAIT Rate 仍高达 55%、59.1% 和 45.8%；这表明答案准确性、轨迹有效性和隐性失效风险是不同的评估信号。因此，现实中的 LLM 数据代理应当不仅按输出是否匹配参考答案评估，也应按这些输出是否由可审计计算支撑评估。
items.author_line: Srimonti Dutta, Akshata Kishore Moharir

items.title: DCGC: Draft-Conditioned Global Correction for Complex Reasoning with Masked Diffusion Models
items.abstract_or_text: Correcting flawed reasoning traces remains a significant challenge for Large Language Models (LLMs), whose autoregressive generation can propagate early mistakes into subsequent reasoning. We introduce DCGC, a Masked Diffusion Model (MDM) framework for global correction that uses an imperfect solution draft from an upstream solver as auxiliary context. DCGC combines task-specific Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) with a novel inference-time mechanism called Dynamic Dual-CFG. This mechanism separates problem-only and joint problem-draft branches and scales the draft-conditioned residual using a relative confidence gap. Across math, code, and knowledge reasoning benchmarks, DCGC outperforms standard sampling and simpler CFG variants, with additional results suggesting transfer to different diffusion backbones. In test-time setting where ground-truth failure labels are unavailable, DCGC improves full test set accuracy by correcting low-consensus upstream outputs, highlighting its utility as a verifier-free global correction module for difficult reasoning instances.
items.summary_zh: DCGC 使用上游求解器的不完整草稿作为条件，通过掩码扩散模型进行全局纠错，并在数学、代码和知识推理基准上与采样及 CFG 变体比较。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究针对长推理中早期错误扩散的问题，评估在没有真实失败标签的测试时环境中纠正低共识输出的可行性。
items.abstract_zh: 纠正有缺陷的推理轨迹仍是大语言模型（LLM）面临的一项重大挑战，因为其自回归生成会将早期错误传播到后续推理中。我们提出 DCGC，一种用于全局纠错的 Masked Diffusion Model（MDM）框架，它利用来自上游求解器的不完美解答草稿作为辅助上下文。DCGC 将任务特定的监督微调（SFT）与一种名为 Dynamic Dual-CFG 的新型推理时机制结合。该机制将仅问题分支与问题—草稿联合分支分离，并利用相对置信度差距缩放草稿条件残差。在数学、代码和知识推理基准上，DCGC 优于标准采样和更简单的 CFG 变体；附加结果提示其可迁移至不同的扩散骨干网络。在测试时无法获得真实失败标签的设置中，DCGC 通过纠正低共识的上游输出提高了全测试集准确率，显示出其作为困难推理实例的无需验证器全局纠错模块的实用性。
items.author_line: Minhae Oh, Nakyung Lee, Jungwoo Lee

items.title: FuzzingBrain-Bench V1: Evaluating Open-Ended Bug Discovery by LLMs
items.abstract_or_text: Evaluating the ability of large language models (LLMs) to discover software bugs is increasingly important. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate this capability by asking the model to generate a proof-of-concept input that triggers a predefined target vulnerability. However, this setup may overlook valid crashes discovered by the model when they do not match the predefined target. As a result, the evaluation may not reflect the model's real capability. We present FuzzingBrain-Bench, a benchmark for assessing AI models' ability to discover bugs in open-source software. Models are given an open-source project and a sanitizer-instrumented harness in a self-contained Docker image. Their goal is to generate inputs that trigger as many distinct crashes as possible through the harness. A model's performance on each challenge is scored based on the number of distinct crash signatures it produces, capped at a predefined maximum and weighted by a difficulty coefficient. FuzzingBrain-Bench V1 consists of 77 challenges drawn from 43 open-source projects, with 36 C, 32 C++, and 9 Java/JVM challenges. We evaluate Claude Haiku 4.5, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Claude Opus 4.8 on the full benchmark. Claude Opus 4.8 performs best, triggering crashes in 60 of 77 challenges and achieving a score of 196 out of 579. None of the three models triggers a crash in 13 challenges. The FuzzingBrain-Bench corpus and harnesses are publicly available at https://github.com/fuzzingbrain/FuzzingBrain-Bench.
items.summary_zh: FuzzingBrain-Bench V1 用带 sanitizer 的可执行 harness，按模型触发的不同崩溃签名数量评估开放式漏洞发现能力，覆盖 77 个开源软件挑战。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 崩溃是否实际触发可由执行结果确认，评测不局限于预设漏洞样本，因此更接近模型发现未知错误的实际任务。
items.abstract_zh: 评估大语言模型（LLM）发现软件错误的能力日益重要。现有基准通常要求模型生成能触发预定义目标漏洞的概念验证输入来评估这一能力。然而，当模型发现的有效崩溃不匹配预定义目标时，这种设置可能会忽略它们。因此，该评估可能无法反映模型的真实能力。我们提出 FuzzingBrain-Bench，这是一个评估 AI 模型在开源软件中发现错误能力的基准。模型会获得一个开源项目以及自包含 Docker 镜像中的、经 sanitizer 插桩的 harness。它们的目标是通过该 harness 生成尽可能多触发不同崩溃的输入。模型在每个挑战上的表现按其产生的不同崩溃签名数量评分，分数设有预定义上限并按难度系数加权。FuzzingBrain-Bench V1 包含来自 43 个开源项目的 77 项挑战，其中包括 36 个 C、32 个 C++ 和 9 个 Java/JVM 挑战。我们在完整基准上评估 Claude Haiku 4.5、Claude Sonnet 4.6 和 Claude Opus 4.8。Claude Opus 4.8 表现最佳，在 77 项挑战中的 60 项触发了崩溃，取得 579 分中的 196 分。三个模型均未能在 13 项挑战中触发崩溃。FuzzingBrain-Bench 语料和 harness 已公开于 https://github.com/fuzzingbrain/FuzzingBrain-Bench。
items.author_line: Ze Sheng, Aleksandar Kezic, Zhicheng Chen, Jeff Huang

items.title: Joint Optimization of Tool Creation and Use for Large Language Model Agents
items.abstract_or_text: Tool-augmented language models are bounded by the APIs humans bothered to write; existing tool-creation systems patch this by prompting a frozen LLM at inference time, leaving the model that writes a tool decoupled from the one that uses it, with no signal that the schemas it produces are schemas it can invoke. We propose SMITH (Schema-grounded Multi-task Iterative Tool Honing), a reinforcement learning framework that jointly trains tool creation and tool use inside a single policy. Each rollout is either a build task (write a tool from a few examples) or a use task (invoke a pooled tool on a held-out question). Three separate reward axes catch schema, code, and outcome failures independently, so each failure mode contributes its own gradient. A 4B Qwen3 trained with SMITH on 13 procedural reasoning tasks with exact verifiers reaches 79.8 macro-average accuracy on held-out tasks, the best across all evaluated methods and ahead of an untrained 30B-A3B tool-writer. It also reaches 40.4 on TabMWP-Hard and 42.6 on out-of-domain GQA (+7.6 over the best same-backbone inference-time baseline), without any visual or tabular training data. Tools written by our 4B models also lifted the performance of LFM-2.5-350M and Qwen3-30B-A3B under same reasoning tasks.
items.summary_zh: SMITH 联合训练 LLM 的工具创建和工具调用，并在带精确验证器的程序推理任务中分别奖励模式、代码和结果正确性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工具编写与使用在同一策略中受结果验证约束，提供了检验代理能否生成可调用工具、而非只产生表面合理代码的实验设置。
items.abstract_zh: 工具增强语言模型受限于人们已经编写出的 API；现有工具创建系统在推理时通过提示一个冻结 LLM 来弥补这一点，使编写工具的模型与使用工具的模型脱节，也没有信号表明它生成的模式是自己能够调用的模式。我们提出 SMITH（Schema-grounded Multi-task Iterative Tool Honing），一个在单一策略内联合训练工具创建和工具使用的强化学习框架。每次 rollout 要么是构建任务（从少量示例编写工具），要么是使用任务（在留出问题上调用汇集的工具）。三条相互独立的奖励轴分别捕捉模式、代码和结果失效，因此每种失效模式都贡献各自的梯度。在 13 个具有精确验证器的程序推理任务上训练的 4B Qwen3，SMITH 在留出任务上达到 79.8 的宏平均准确率，在所有评估方法中最佳，并超过未经训练的 30B-A3B 工具编写器。它还在 TabMWP-Hard 上达到 40.4、在分布外 GQA 上达到 42.6（比同骨干推理时基线中最优者高 7.6），且未使用任何视觉或表格训练数据。由我们的 4B 模型编写的工具，也提升了 LFM-2.5-350M 和 Qwen3-30B-A3B 在相同推理任务上的表现。
items.author_line: Zhi Rui Tam, Chieh-Yen Lin, Yun-Nung Chen, Shao-Hua Sun, Hung-yi Lee

items.title: PhysicsBench: A Unified Leaderboard for Generative and Predictive Models in Engineering Design and Simulation
items.abstract_or_text: Generative and predictive artificial intelligence models are increasingly used to generate geometry and to predict physical fields and scalar quantities in engineering design and simulation. Yet these models are typically evaluated in isolation, on academic datasets at unconstrained scales, with inconsistent metrics and procedures. We present PhysicsBench, a unified benchmark and leaderboard that evaluates generative and predictive models under one standardized procedure. PhysicsBench spans seven generation and prediction tasks across 1D, 2D, and 3D domains and ranks 66 models on nine datasets, comprising industrial-scale CAD/CFD/FEA simulations and public references, expanded into 28 configurations. One procedure and ranking apply to both families, each ranked within its own tasks. Evaluation spans realistic, limited data scales from S to XL rather than the unlimited training sets common in academic benchmarks. A common metric suite captures geometric fidelity with distributional distances, physical-field and scalar accuracy, and engineering-specific field- and shape-validity. BenchRank debiases correlated metrics and ranks by PageRank over a head-to-head dominance graph, so every reported quality metric is also ranked, with computational cost in a separate efficiency view. Across tasks, an architecture's large-scale academic standing weakly predicts its small-data ranking. The top model changes with data scale in six of the seven tasks, and no model leads more than one task. PhysicsBench turns "state-of-the-art" from a self-reported claim into an openly published foundation for model selection.
items.summary_zh: PhysicsBench 在统一流程下评估工程设计与仿真中的生成式、预测式模型，覆盖七类任务、九个数据集和 66 个模型。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 统一指标、受限数据规模和独立效率视图使工程模型比较更可检验，也显示模型排序会随数据量和任务改变。
items.abstract_zh: 生成式和预测式人工智能模型日益用于工程设计和仿真中的几何生成，以及物理场与标量量预测。然而，这些模型通常被孤立地评估于不受规模约束的学术数据集上，所用指标和流程也不一致。我们提出 PhysicsBench：一个在统一标准化流程下评估生成式和预测式模型的统一基准与排行榜。PhysicsBench 覆盖一维、二维和三维领域中的七项生成与预测任务，在九个数据集上对 66 个模型进行排名；这些数据集由工业规模的 CAD/CFD/FEA 仿真和公共参考组成，并扩展为 28 种配置。一个流程和一套排名同时适用于两类模型，且每类模型仅在各自任务内排名。评估覆盖从 S 到 XL 的现实有限数据规模，而非学术基准中常见的无限训练集。通用指标组通过分布距离刻画几何保真度，并衡量物理场和标量准确性，以及工程特定的场与形状有效性。BenchRank 通过头对头支配图上的 PageRank 消除相关指标偏差，并对每个报告的质量指标进行排名；计算成本则在单独的效率视图中呈现。跨任务来看，一种架构在大规模学术数据上的排名只能较弱地预测其小数据排名。七项任务中有六项的最优模型会随数据规模变化，且没有模型在超过一项任务中领先。PhysicsBench 将“最先进”的自我声明转化为一个公开发布、可用于模型选择的基础。
items.author_line: Sang Won Lee, Hyogu Jeong, Namwoo Kang

items.title: BixBench3: Benchmarking AI agents on research-study-scale computational biology tasks
items.abstract_or_text: Artificial intelligence (AI) promises to accelerate biological research by automating computational analyses. Yet the ability of AI agents to carry out computational biology at the scale of complete research studies has not been systematically evaluated. Here we introduce BixBench3, a benchmark that measures the capacity of AI agents to process raw biological data through to scientific results. We designed BixBench3 tasks to mirror the delegation of work from a scientist to an agent: the scientist chooses the research question and high-level methods, then delegates implementation of all analyses to the agent. In each task, an agent receives a research objective, methodological guidance, and raw data derived from a published scientific study, and must execute a sequence of analyses to achieve the research objective. The data artifacts resulting from these analyses - such as peak call matrices or differential expression tables - are programmatically graded against the corresponding artifacts generated and reported in the original study. Across 20 BixBench3 tasks encompassing the generation of 138 unique artifacts, we find that 13 frontier models achieve scores ranging from 0.00 for Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite to 0.48 for GPT 5.6 Sol. Agents perform worse on tasks with larger raw datasets (0.36 on tasks with 100 GB) and on analyses requiring more sequential steps (0.36 at 1-2 steps vs 0.24 at 3+). On average, agents use 6.8 hours, 102 million tokens, and 43 to complete each task, with the longest attempts consuming 24 hours, 1.07 billion tokens, and 525. Notably, the highest-scoring agents used fewer tokens and were cheaper than less performant options. These results reveal that LLMs vary substantially in their ability to (1) execute multiple sequential analysis steps coherently, (2) manage large quantities of raw data, and (3) work across scientific domains.
items.summary_zh: BixBench3 以发表研究的原始生物数据和程序化比对的分析产物，评估代理完成研究规模计算生物学任务的能力。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 评测对象是峰调用矩阵、差异表达表等可程序判定产物，并报告规模、步骤数、时间、token 和成本的关联，能较具体地刻画能力局限。
items.abstract_zh: 人工智能（AI）有望通过自动化计算分析加速生物学研究。然而，AI 代理能否完成达到完整研究规模的计算生物学工作，尚未得到系统评估。本文提出 BixBench3：一个衡量 AI 代理从原始生物数据处理直至得到科学结果能力的基准。我们将 BixBench3 任务设计为科学家向代理委派工作的情境：科学家选择研究问题和高层方法，然后将所有分析的实施委派给代理。在每项任务中，代理获得一个研究目标、方法学指导和源自已发表科学研究的原始数据，并必须执行一系列分析以实现研究目标。这些分析产生的数据产物，例如 peak call 矩阵或差异表达表，会以程序方式与原始研究生成并报告的相应产物进行评分。BixBench3 的 20 项任务共涵盖 138 种独特产物。我们发现，13 个前沿模型的得分从 Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite 的 0.00 到 GPT 5.6 Sol 的 0.48 不等。代理在原始数据集更大的任务上表现较差（100 GB 任务上为 0.36），在需要更多串行步骤的分析上也更差（1—2 步为 0.36，3 步及以上为 0.24）。平均而言，代理完成每项任务需要 6.8 小时、1.02 亿 token 和 43；最长的尝试消耗 24 小时、10.7 亿 token 和 525。值得注意的是，得分最高的代理比性能较弱的选项使用更少 token、成本也更低。这些结果揭示，LLM 在以下能力上存在显著差异：（1）连贯执行多个串行分析步骤；（2）管理大量原始数据；（3）跨科学领域工作。
items.author_line: Zane Koch, Asmamaw T. Wassie, Javier Valdes-Aleman, Jason Lee, Michaela M. Hinks, Samuel G. Rodriques, Andrew D. White, Jon M. Laurent

items.title: Constraint-Guided Enterprise Data Mapping with Large Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Enterprise entity alignment must handle semi-structured records, implicit attributes, and unit or granularity mismatches. Manual matching is still common in practice, but does not scale as schemas and providers evolve. LLM-only matching improves semantic recall, yet can violate structural and physical invariants, producing fluent yet operationally invalid correspondences. We propose constraint-guided mapping (CGM), a neuro-symbolic method with three stages: (i) schema-grounded admissibility constraints with metadata mc = , where tau_c denotes the constraint type and delta_c provides executable relation and normalization logic; (ii) constraint-restricted candidate generation with cascade relaxation to guarantee a nonempty feasible set under noise; and (iii) neural ranking with bounded LLM disambiguation restricted to that feasible set. Methodologically, constraints operate as hypothesis-space operators rather than post-hoc validators, enabling controlled degradation under relaxation and auditable, human-guidable decisions. On a controlled structural-decoy benchmark, hard admissibility shrinks the candidate space by ~480x without dropping the GT, and a layer-by-layer ablation shows this gate, not the LLM, is the decisive lift (F1 0.08 to 0.66). The benefit is model-independent and adds no extra inference cost: a small model with constraints matches a frontier LLM used without them at ~28x lower cost. The method, not a single tuned configuration, transfers across seven enterprise makes (macro F1 0.70), each under its own automatically discovered, expert-refinable constraints, and lowers expert effort by ~7x versus spreadsheet workflows. Public Valentine results add an external ranking sanity check and mark the boundary: constraints should be hard only where structural invariants are match-determining.
items.summary_zh: Constraint-Guided Mapping 将模式、物理和粒度约束用于企业实体对齐的候选生成与排序，并用结构诱饵基准和跨行业数据测试其效果。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果通过候选空间缩减、逐层消融和外部排名检验说明性能来源，显示结构约束可为 LLM 映射提供可审计的可行解集合。
items.abstract_zh: 企业实体对齐必须处理半结构化记录、隐含属性以及单位或粒度不匹配。实践中仍常依靠人工匹配，但随着模式和提供方演变，这种方法难以扩展。仅用 LLM 的匹配提高了语义召回率，却可能违反结构和物理不变量，产生语言流畅但在操作上无效的对应关系。我们提出 constraint-guided mapping（CGM），一种包含三个阶段的神经符号方法：（i）带元数据的、以模式为基础的可接受性约束，其中 τc 表示约束类型，δc 提供可执行的关系和归一化逻辑；（ii）在约束限制下进行候选生成，并采用级联放宽以确保在噪声下仍有非空可行集合；（iii）在该可行集合内进行神经排序和受限的 LLM 消歧。方法上，约束作为假设空间算子而非事后验证器，因而能够在放宽时实现受控退化，并形成可审计、可由人工引导的决策。在受控结构诱饵基准上，硬可接受性将候选空间缩小约 480 倍，同时不丢失真实标注；逐层消融显示，决定性提升来自这一步，而非 LLM（F1 从 0.08 升至 0.66）。该收益与模型无关且不增加额外推理成本：带约束的小模型以约低 28 倍的成本，达到前沿 LLM 无约束使用时的水平。该方法跨七类企业实现迁移，宏 F1 为 0.70；每类企业都使用其自动发现、可由专家细化的约束，并且相对于电子表格工作流将专家工作量降低约 7 倍。公开 Valentine 结果提供外部排名合理性检查，也指出了适用条件：只有当结构不变量决定匹配结果时，约束才应设为硬约束。
items.author_line: Sebastian Monka, Pramod Anantharam, Thien Vo Minh, Lavdim Halilaj

items.title: PARTAB: Partition-Aware Reasoning with Structured Evidence for Scalable Table Understanding
items.abstract_or_text: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong capabilities in table reasoning, but their effectiveness degrades as tables grow in size and complexity due to irrelevant context and difficulty localizing the evidence required for reasoning. Existing approaches typically reason over either the full table or a single reduced view, which can still obscure important row-column relationships. We introducePARTAB (Partition-Aware Reasoning overTables), a framework that constructs a structured evidence interface between the LLM and the table. PARTAB represents query-relevant evidence as semantically coherent, row-linked table regions and performs hierarchical selection over column groups and row-level partitions before composing the selected evidence for answer generation. We evaluate PARTAB on multiple table reasoning benchmarks, covering question answering, fact verification, and numerical reasoning. PARTAB consistently improves over full-table prompting and several recent table reasoning methods, achieving strong performance on WikiTableQuestions and TabFact while remaining competitive on numerical reasoning. Additional analyses show that semantic partitioning and targeted evidence selection improve evidence localization, substantially reduce the reasoning context, and provide larger benefits on complex tables. These results demonstrate the value of structured, partition aware evidence construction for scalable table reasoning.
items.summary_zh: PARTAB 先按列组和行分区分层选择与问题相关的表格证据，再生成答案，并在问答、事实核验和数值推理基准上比较。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它提供可追溯的证据组织方式，用以检验长表格中的上下文缩减和证据定位是否真正改善模型推理。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）已在表格推理中展示出较强能力，但随着表格规模和复杂度增加，由于无关上下文以及难以定位推理所需证据，其有效性会下降。现有方法通常要么基于完整表格推理，要么基于单一缩减视图推理，这仍可能掩盖重要的行列关系。我们提出 PARTAB（Partition-Aware Reasoning over Tables），这是一个在 LLM 与表格之间构建结构化证据接口的框架。PARTAB 将与查询相关的证据表示为语义连贯、按行关联的表格区域，并在组合所选证据生成答案之前，对列组和行级分区进行分层选择。我们在多个表格推理基准上评估 PARTAB，涵盖问答、事实核验和数值推理。PARTAB 持续优于全表提示和若干近期表格推理方法，在 WikiTableQuestions 和 TabFact 上取得强劲表现，同时在数值推理上保持竞争力。附加分析显示，语义分区和目标证据选择改进了证据定位，大幅减少推理上下文，并在复杂表格上带来更大收益。这些结果表明，结构化、分区感知的证据构建对于可扩展表格推理具有价值。
items.author_line: Md Mahadi Hasan Nahid, Davood Rafiei

items.title: FinRiskAtlas: Decision-Aligned Evaluation of Large Language Models for Financial Risk Review
items.abstract_or_text: Deploying large language models for professional financial review requires more than measuring general financial competence: models must perform the specific review operation required by a workflow and determine whether available evidence is sufficient for a defensible decision. Existing financial benchmarks cover knowledge, reasoning, compliance, and professional tasks, but their evaluation units are often organized around datasets or task formulations rather than the decisions that deployed systems support. We introduce FinRiskAtlas, a Chinese-language benchmark that evaluates financial LLMs along two complementary dimensions: operation execution under fixed evidence states and evidence-state control under evolving review conditions. The static benchmark contains 9,742 instances across 53 task families, including 42 Domain Knowledge families and eleven downstream review operations defined by explicit evaluation contracts. FinRisk-Ask extends this framework through offline replay of 680 pre-action states from 104 de-identified professional trajectories, withholding future evidence during inference and using it only to construct expert-verified evidence targets. Across 33 model configurations, operation-level evaluation yields non-redundant rankings (mean pairwise Spearman correlation 0.42 across downstream operations), and knowledge-based shortlisting can incur up to 18.01 points of regret on individual operations. FinRisk-Ask further shows that entering the Ask branch more frequently does not necessarily improve request targeting or end-to-end evidence acquisition. These results show that broad financial capability scores do not fully capture where models are reliable in professional workflows, motivating evaluation units aligned with the decisions and evidence states that deployed systems must support.
items.summary_zh: FinRiskAtlas 以固定证据状态下的操作执行和动态审查中的证据状态控制，评估金融风险审查模型，并公开任务家族与模型配置的比较结果。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该基准将泛化的金融知识分数与具体审查操作区分开，可检验模型是否具备支持专业决策所需的证据判断能力。
items.abstract_zh: 将大语言模型部署到专业金融审查中，所需的不只是衡量一般金融能力：模型必须执行工作流所要求的特定审查操作，并判断现有证据是否足以支持可辩护的决策。现有金融基准覆盖知识、推理、合规和专业任务，但它们的评估单元通常围绕数据集或任务表述组织，而非围绕已部署系统所支持的决策。我们提出 FinRiskAtlas，一个中文基准，沿两个互补维度评估金融 LLM：固定证据状态下的操作执行，以及不断演变的审查条件下的证据状态控制。静态基准包含 53 个任务家族的 9,742 个实例，其中包括 42 个领域知识家族和 11 个由明确评估契约定义的下游审查操作。FinRisk-Ask 通过对来自 104 条去标识化专业轨迹的 680 个行动前状态进行离线重放来扩展该框架：推理时隐藏未来证据，仅用其构建经专家验证的证据目标。在 33 种模型配置中，操作层面的评估产生非冗余排名（下游操作间平均两两 Spearman 相关系数为 0.42），而基于知识的初筛在个别操作上可造成最高 18.01 分的遗憾值。FinRisk-Ask 还显示，更频繁地进入 Ask 分支未必改善请求定位或端到端证据获取。这些结果表明，广泛的金融能力分数无法充分反映模型在专业工作流中何处可靠，因此需要与已部署系统必须支持的决策和证据状态相一致的评估单元。
items.author_line: Suyang Zhong, Jingzhe Zhu, Qi Xu, Liyao Sun, Yin Wang, Qingqing Sun, Shuai Chen, Tianyi Zhang

items.title: LLM-Driven, Datasheet-Aware Automated Hardware Compatibility Verification for Early-Stage, Pre-Schematic Embedded System Design
items.abstract_or_text: We present an LLM-driven, datasheet-aware framework for early-stage hardware compatibility verification that identifies documentation-level interface incompatibilities based on hardware datasheets and high-level component connectivity descriptions. It does not require, and can therefore be used, before detailed schematic simulation and implementation. We view trustworthy LLM-assisted design automation not as directly generating answers from documents, but as transforming engineering information through traceable verification stages. Given hardware datasheets and high-level component connectivity descriptions, the framework constructs a design graph that captures device connectivity and shared interaction domains, retrieves only the engineering properties required by explicit, domain-oriented verification criteria , and generates deterministic scripts for compatibility evaluation. By decomposing compatibility analysis into modular stages and preserving intermediate results, the framework reduces context overhead, improves transparency and tractability, enables scaling, and avoids reliance on LLMs for numerical computation. Evaluated on seven embedded-system designs comprising 34 datasheets, our framework achieves 97.5% compatibility-verification accuracy and an 8.6 times reduction in input context size compared with ``upload-and-query'' workflows. These results demonstrate the feasibility of LLM-assisted, specification-based hardware compatibility verification at an early design stage, as well as the need for, and substantial benefits of, modular task decomposition, formalized verification criteria, and task-aware compact context construction.
items.summary_zh: 该框架从数据手册和高层连接描述构建设计图，以显式规则检索工程属性并生成确定性兼容性检查脚本，在原理图设计前发现接口不兼容。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 数值计算交给确定性脚本，且保留中间结果；在七个嵌入式设计上的准确率和上下文缩减结果为 LLM 辅助规范验证提供了可检查证据。
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个由 LLM 驱动、具备数据手册感知能力的早期硬件兼容性验证框架。该框架根据硬件数据手册和高层组件连接描述，识别文档层面的接口不兼容性。它无须详细原理图仿真和实现，因此可在这些工作之前使用。我们将可信的 LLM 辅助设计自动化视为经由可追溯验证阶段转换工程信息的过程。给定硬件数据手册和高层组件连接描述，该框架构建设计图以捕捉器件连接和共享交互域；只检索显式、面向领域的验证准则所需工程属性；并生成用于兼容性评估的确定性脚本。通过将兼容性分析拆分为模块化阶段并保留中间结果，该框架减少上下文开销，提高透明度和可处理性，支持扩展，并避免依赖 LLM 进行数值计算。在由 34 份数据手册组成的七个嵌入式系统设计上评估时，相较于“上传后询问”工作流，该框架实现了 97.5% 的兼容性验证准确率，并将输入上下文规模减少 8.6 倍。这些结果表明，LLM 辅助、基于规范的硬件兼容性验证可在早期设计阶段实施，也表明模块化任务拆分、形式化验证准则和任务感知的紧凑上下文构建具有重要益处。
items.author_line: Haotian Qiao, Robert P. Dick

items.title: The Imperfective Paradox Is Not Necessarily in Large Language Models: A Benchmark Failure Before a Model Failure
items.abstract_or_text: The imperfective paradox provides a useful test of compositional semantic analysis. Recent work constructs an NLI benchmark and reports that models frequently infer completed telic events from progressive descriptions, attributing this behavior to a Teleological Bias. It further argues that prompting interventions cause a Calibration Crisis. We reexamine the benchmark and conclusions and show that it is substantially affected by conceptual and evaluation mis-specifications. We identify three conceptual mis-specifications. In particular, Aspectual Reduction affects the benchmark construction, analysis, experiments, and conclusions. Under a strict NLI standard, 76% of Group A instances do not explicitly rule out culmination. In our native-speaker annotation, 38% of Group A examples and 29% of the Group C examples were judged to permit an alternative interpretation. To control these issues and lexical variation, we construct Lexically Matched Minimal Pairs. At the evaluation level, we formulate event-semantic NLI as a Multi-step Reasoning Problem and assess both intermediate semantic decisions and final predictions. Our results show that models often do not affirm culmination but nevertheless accept the corresponding simple-past hypothesis, a pattern we characterize as Sufficiency Bias. We further show that prompting interventions produce a Decision Shift among labels without reliably improving the underlying semantic understanding and reasoning. Intermediate and oracle-guided analyses identify two additional failure modes: errors in compositional aspectual classification and Surface-form Attraction toward surface-associated answers. Our experiments on Qwen-7B with suitable prompts, GPT-5.4, and Qwen-72B provide initial evidence for the context sensitivity of aspectual classification and suggest that these models can achieve performance comparable to that of human annotators.
items.summary_zh: 该研究复查“未完成体悖论”自然语言推理基准的构造与标签，构建词汇匹配最小对，并用中间语义决策和最终预测共同评估模型。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它通过人工标注、受控最小对和中间步骤分析，检验模型在语义推理上的表现是否被基准歧义和表面答案偏好混淆。
items.abstract_zh: 未完成体悖论为组合语义分析提供了有用测试。近期工作构建了一个 NLI 基准，并报告模型经常从进行体描述中推断有界事件已经完成，将这种行为归因于 Teleological Bias。该工作还认为提示干预会造成 Calibration Crisis。我们重新审视该基准及其结论，发现它们受到实质性的概念和评估设定错误影响。我们识别出三项概念设定错误。尤其是，Aspectual Reduction 影响了基准构建、分析、实验和结论。按严格的 NLI 标准，Group A 实例中 76% 并未明确排除完成。我们的母语者标注中，Group A 的 38% 示例和 Group C 的 29% 示例被认为允许另一种解释。为控制这些问题和词汇变化，我们构建了 Lexically Matched Minimal Pairs。在评估层面，我们将事件语义 NLI 表述为 Multi-step Reasoning Problem，并同时评估中间语义决策与最终预测。结果显示，模型常常不肯定完成，却仍接受相应的简单过去时假设；我们将这种模式称为 Sufficiency Bias。我们还显示，提示干预会造成标签之间的 Decision Shift，却不能可靠改善潜在的语义理解与推理。中间分析和 oracle-guided 分析识别出另外两种失效模式：组合体分类错误，以及朝向表面关联答案的 Surface-form Attraction。我们在采用合适提示的 Qwen-7B、GPT-5.4 和 Qwen-72B 上的实验，为体分类的语境敏感性提供了初步证据，并提示这些模型能够达到与人类标注者相当的表现。

items.title: PeakBench: Benchmarking Resource-Aware Tool Invocation in LLM Agents
items.abstract_or_text: LLM agents increasingly solve tasks by invoking multiple tools, where parallel execution is essential for low latency but difficult to manage safely. Existing agent benchmarks primarily evaluate tool selection, argument generation, and end-to-end success under mostly serial execution, largely overlooking valid parallelization and resource-constrained scheduling. This missing scheduling dimension creates a practical failure mode: serial execution is safe but slow, while resource-agnostic parallel execution is fast but prone to avoidable resource overflows. To address this gap, we introduce PeakBench, a benchmark of executable multi-tool workflows with execution-grounded dependency annotations and measured resource profiles. A central challenge in evaluating such workflows is attribution: failures and inefficiencies may arise from incorrect dependency planning, poor resource-constrained scheduling, or both. PeakBench addresses this challenge with a two-part evaluation framework that disentangles logical planning from physical scheduling, with dedicated metrics for each dimension. Using this framework, we show that strong logical planning does not reliably translate into safe or efficient execution under resource constraints. We further show that exposing resource information can reduce avoidable overflows and improve resource utilization, making PeakBench a useful testbed for diagnosing resource-aware agent behavior. Code is available at https://github.com/Czzzk/Staggering-the-Peaks.
items.summary_zh: PeakBench 以可执行多工具工作流、依赖标注和资源测量，分别评估 LLM 代理的逻辑规划与资源受限调度。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该基准将依赖规划错误和物理调度错误分开计量，可用于检验代理在并行调用工具时是否安全、有效地利用资源。
items.abstract_zh: LLM 代理越来越多地通过调用多个工具来解决任务，其中并行执行对于低延迟至关重要，却难以安全管理。现有代理基准主要评估工具选择、参数生成和大多串行执行下的端到端成功，基本忽略有效并行化和资源受限调度。这一缺失的调度维度带来实际失效模式：串行执行安全但缓慢，而不考虑资源的并行执行快速却容易发生本可避免的资源溢出。为解决这一缺口，我们提出 PeakBench，一个由可执行多工具工作流组成的基准，包含基于执行的依赖标注和测得的资源配置。评估此类工作流的一项核心挑战是归因：失败和低效可能来自不正确的依赖规划、较差的资源受限调度，或二者兼有。PeakBench 通过一个两部分评估框架解决该问题，该框架将逻辑规划与物理调度区分开来，并为每个维度设置专用指标。借助这一框架，我们显示，强逻辑规划并不能可靠转化为资源约束下安全或高效的执行。我们还显示，公开资源信息可以减少可避免的溢出并改善资源利用率，使 PeakBench 成为诊断资源感知代理行为的有用测试平台。代码见 https://github.com/Czzzk/Staggering-the-Peaks。

items.title: RecurSE: Bounded Recursive Self-Evaluation for LLM Rubric Judges
items.abstract_or_text: LLM-as-judge is essential for evaluating open-ended text and steering post-training, yet improving the judge itself typically relies on expensive annotations, reward models, or distillation from stronger teachers. In this work, we eliminate external gold supervision from the RL training reward: the model's own evaluative capability generates learning signals for its optimization -- a closed-loop setting of bounded recursive self-improvement (RSI) termed Recursive Self-Evaluation (RecurSE). We study two central questions: when can self-improvement occur, and when must it stop? First, RecurSE pairs a trainable judge evaluating candidate responses under per-rule rubrics (Pass 1) with a synchronized policy-copy checker that audits the judge's reasoning against meta-rubrics to supply a scalar process reward (Pass 2). To enable learning, interface decoupling structurally isolates the checker's scalar score from the judge's verdict tokens, eliminating a degenerative token-copying shortcut that inflates self-assigned rewards. Second, because unanchored recursive learning is inherently bounded, Pairwise Advantage Validity (PAV) serves as an unbiased validation monitor that jointly tracks judge accuracy and checker fidelity to reliably identify the optimal early-stopping window. Across Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma-4-E4B-it, and Qwen3.6-27B, RecurSE achieves consistent generalization gains across held-out medical, pairwise, summarization, and professional benchmarks. Ablations demonstrate that synchronized judge-checker co-evolution outperforms frozen checkers, external meta-judges, self-consistency, and scaled teacher distillation. Furthermore, preference pairs curated by our judge effectively enhance downstream policy alignment. Bounded RSI for LLM-as-judge is thus viable when self-produced reward validity is explicitly decoupled and monitored.
items.summary_zh: RecurSE 让可训练评审器和同步策略副本检查器构成受限递归自评过程，并以 PAV 监控评审准确性与检查器忠实度。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它直接研究无外部金标准奖励下自评改进何时有效、何时应停止，并用留出基准和消融比较评估其稳定性。
items.abstract_zh: LLM-as-judge 对评估开放式文本和引导后训练至关重要，但改进评审器本身通常依赖昂贵标注、奖励模型或来自更强教师的蒸馏。在这项工作中，我们从强化学习训练奖励中去除外部金标准监督：模型自身的评估能力为其优化生成学习信号——这是一种称为 Recursive Self-Evaluation（RecurSE）的受限递归自我改进（RSI）闭环设置。我们研究两个核心问题：自我改进何时能够发生，以及何时必须停止？首先，RecurSE 将一个依据逐规则 rubric 评估候选回答的可训练评审器（Pass 1），与一个同步策略副本检查器配对；后者根据元 rubric 审计评审器的推理，以提供标量过程奖励（Pass 2）。为使学习成为可能，接口解耦在结构上将检查器的标量分数与评审器的判定 token 隔离，消除了会虚增自评奖励的退化 token 复制捷径。其次，由于无外部约束的递归学习天然受限，Pairwise Advantage Validity（PAV）充当无偏验证监控器，同时跟踪评审器准确性和检查器忠实度，以可靠识别最优早停窗口。在 Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma-4-E4B-it 和 Qwen3.6-27B 上，RecurSE 在留出的医疗、成对比较、摘要和专业基准中取得一致的泛化提升。消融表明，同步的评审器—检查器共同演化优于冻结检查器、外部元评审器、自洽性以及规模化教师蒸馏。此外，由我们的评审器筛选的偏好对能够有效增强下游策略对齐。当自生成奖励的有效性得到明确解耦和监控时，针对 LLM-as-judge 的受限 RSI 是可行的。

items.abstract_or_text: Honored to be named one of the 100 most influential people in AI by @TIME right on the heels of the public launch of our company Accelerated Understanding @accelerated_u Bringing the power of AI+Science together has been the focus of my life for the past decade. I believe the greatest impact AI can have on science and engineering is its ability to massively accelerate simulation and understanding of the physical world. We started this journey with the invention of Neural Operators at @Caltech to have a powerful foundation for AI modeling physical phenomena at multiple scales. Together with my team at @nvidia and support from @JensenHuang himself we built FourCastNet, the first high-resolution AI-weather model that is tens of thousands of times faster than existing systems. Following up on this success we have applied Neural Operators to accelerating simulation of nuclear fusion to detect disruptions before they happen in the real world. Just this week, we announced how Neural Operators can enable density functional theory simulation in quantum chemistry quasi-linear time. We have also used Neural Operators to invent better medical devices like a catheter that reduces bacterial contamination by 100x and we have been able to design better masks for chips and optimized gate layouts for quantum dots. More recently we have been asking ourselves what would happen if we aggressively scale our models and put multiple areas of physics in the same model, teaching it physics in full 4D (3D space + time). This requires massive scale and that is exactly what we have been able to do at Accelerated Understanding. We have pre-trained models up to 1 Trillion parameters, and we are able to train at 4D context lengths of up to 1 Trillion and run inference at 5 Trillion context.
items.summary_zh: Anima Anandkumar 回顾 Neural Operators 在天气、核聚变、量子化学、医疗器械和芯片设计中的应用，并阐述其新公司对大规模四维物理模型的方向判断。帖中参数规模、性能和应用效果均为作者自述。

items.abstract_zh: 很荣幸被评为 TIME 百大最具影响力 AI 人物之一，正值我们公司 Accelerated Understanding @accelerated_u 公开发布之际。将 AI+Science 的力量结合起来，一直是我过去十年的生活重心。我相信，AI 对科学和工程的最大影响，是能大幅加速对物理世界的模拟与理解。我们在 @Caltech 发明 Neural Operators，作为用于多尺度 AI 建模物理现象的强大基础，由此启程。随后我与 @nvidia 的团队、并在 @JensenHuang 本人的支持下，构建了 FourCastNet——首个高分辨率 AI 天气模型，其速度比既有系统快数万倍。在这一成果之后，我们将 Neural Operators 用于加速核聚变模拟，以在真实世界的扰动发生前加以检测。就在本周，我们宣布 Neural Operators 能以准线性时间支持量子化学中的密度泛函理论模拟。我们还使用 Neural Operators 发明了更好的医疗器械，例如可将细菌污染降低 100 倍的导管；也设计出更好的芯片掩膜，并优化量子点的栅极布局。近来，我们一直在思考：如果积极扩展模型规模，把物理学的多个领域置入同一模型，并让它以完整 4D（3D 空间 + 时间）学习物理，会怎样？这需要巨大的规模，而这正是我们在 Accelerated Understanding 已经能够做到的。我们已预训练了最高达 1 万亿参数的模型，能够在长达 1 万亿的 4D 上下文长度上训练，并在 5 万亿上运行推理。

items.why_it_matters_zh: 构建 MCP 工具接入和人工介入式 agent 的团队需要评估 `MCPAdapter`、FastMCP 4.0.0b4 依赖及新的 elicitation 行为；这类 alpha API 变化可能影响现有集成。
items.abstract_zh: 初始发布。发布说明修复了 MCP 内容类型转换、临近结束会话中的 elicitation 调用、输入请求重试次数以及 PII redaction 中 content block 形状保留问题；新增 `langchain.mcp` 命名空间、`MCPAdapter`、以 LangGraph interrupt 回应 MCP elicitation、`reasoning_effort` 标准聊天模型参数、`ToolErrorMiddleware` 与显式 prompt caching 支持。说明还要求 `mcp` extra 使用 FastMCP 4.0.0b4，并将 elicitation 类型按模式和动作分别定义。

items.abstract_zh: 发布说明新增 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next（qwen4exp）架构与转换器、Hyper-Connections、Gated Delta Net、MoE、PLE n-gram hash embedding 及 QSA sparse attention。其 PLE 卷积状态可跨 ubatch 保存，indexer KV cache 可写入和恢复会话状态；转换过程改为流式写入 128 个 PLE 分片，避免拼接时约 300 GB 的峰值 RSS。`LLAMA_MMAP_RANDOM` 针对随机访问 gather table 提供可选预取：说明中的冷缓存测试将常驻内存从 26.82 GiB 降至 1.19 GiB，且困惑度保持不变。

items.summary_zh: microsoft/DeepSpeed v0.19.6 为 ZeRO、DeepCompile、AutoTP 与 HybridEngine 带来功能和修复，并新增 Apple Silicon MPS 上 ZeRO Stage 1–3 支持及多项显存与内核优化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 训练和推理集群可利用 activation offload、CUDA graph、AutoTP 和 pinned host memory 改善资源使用；Apple Silicon 用户首次获得较完整的 ZeRO 路径，升级前应验证现有 checkpoint、并行和超时配置。
items.abstract_zh: 发布说明修复了 Ulysses sequence parallelism 的 checkpoint rank 选择、ZeRO-3 冻结参数 `KeyError`、AutoTP universal-checkpoint metadata 崩溃、Triton grouped-GEMM expert offset 的 int32 溢出，以及 ZeRO-1/2 的零大小参数问题。新增可配置的梯度求和归约、DeepNVMe 原生 host-memory pinning、`compile.offload_activation_pin_memory`、HybridEngine generation 的 CUDA graph、AutoTP 非均匀分片与 universal checkpoint、fused Triton SwiGLU kernel，以及 Apple Silicon MPS 上的 ZeRO Stage 1–3 和 Metal FusedAdam。NCCL 及其他 backend process-group timeout 由 30 分钟改为 10 分钟。
